# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2888%2E5691347%2E1PhnYt)

Remember, Peter, Trump promised to lower prices on day one...
Instead, the broken old man just threw a two-day party in Texas, while it costs more than ever to fill up your truck, to stock your fridge, and to power your home.
Under the failed President Donald J. Trump, food, diesel, and health care all just hit their all-time highs.
All while the crook president and his crook family raked in billions from all over the world.
Half a billion from the Emirati spy chief to the Trump family crypto business, months before the administration granted the Emirates access to our most sensitive AI chips.
$1.6 billion of your money backing the Trump boys' mining interests in Kazakhstan. Jared Kushner on the Saudi payroll while he pretends to lead our Middle East diplomacy. And on and on.
See, while the world burns, and you pay more for everything, your tax dollars become the royal family’s wealth.
Because it pays to be a Trump, especially when the whole world knows daddy's a crook.
The only way we can put a stop to this endless cycle of corruption and self-enrichment is by regaining Congressional power.
Really.
This upcoming election is our last chance to restore checks and balances. Because if we don’t win this year, I don’t know if we'll make it to 2028.
And this Senate race is the most crucial in the country.
[**So don’t wait. Fellow Conservative: You won't find "RINO" in the dictionary. If we wrote the entry ourselves, it would read something like this:
**RINO** , n. /Rye-No/: _A career politician who runs as a "Republican" but cuts deals with Democrats, abandons conservative principles the moment it's convenient, and won't work more than 2.5 days a week to fight for the country._

That's not a joke. That describes far too many Republicans right now.
Case in point: the SAVE America Act. It simply requires people to prove they're citizens before they vote. It's supported by 80% of Americans. President Trump has championed it. The House has passed it multiple times. One version even got 50 votes in the Senate.
Democrats are fighting it tooth-and-nail — no surprise there. But Senate Republicans have the votes to pass it anyway. Asked why it's stalled, Majority Leader John Thune said plainly: "It's about the votes. It's about the math."
Let's check his math. Republicans ...
✅ Control the House, 218–215.
✅ Control the Senate, 53–47.
✅ Control the White House, 312 electoral votes to 226.
That's not an excuse. That's a mandate. And Senate leadership has every tool it needs to pass it — a talking filibuster, attaching it to a must-pass bill, or by eliminating the filibuster — they just won't.

**This is exactly why "NO RINOS! NO EXCUSES!" has to be our rally cry heading into Election Day.**

Democrats are fighting it tooth-and-nail — no surprise there. But Senate Republicans have the votes to pass it anyway. Asked why it's stalled, Majority Leader John Thune said plainly: "It's about the votes. It's about the math." Let's check his math. Republicans ... ✅ Control the House, 218–215. ✅ Control the Senate, 53–47. ✅ Control the White House, 312 electoral votes to 226. That's not an excuse. That's a mandate. And Senate leadership has every tool it needs to pass it — a talking filibuster, attaching it to a must-pass bill, or by eliminating the filibuster — they just won't. This is exactly why "NO RINOS! NO EXCUSES!" has to be our rally cry heading into Election Day. It's not enough to elect "politicians" just because they have an R next to their name. We need TRUE conservatives — proven fighters who won't fold the second it gets hard. That's why we are backing this group of candidates in the 2026 midterm elections: ▶ Ken Paxton (TX) ▶ Mike Collins (GA) ▶ Roger Marshall (KS) ▶ Ashley Moody (FL) ▶ Kevin Hern (OK) ▶ Harriet Hageman (WY) ▶ Bill Hagerty (TN) ▶ Barry Moore (AL) These candidates have earned SCF's endorsement because they'll fight for election integrity, secure the border, and hold the line on spending — even when it means taking on their own party's leadership. The DC establishment favors moderate Republicans, so it's up to us — the grassroots — to make sure conservatives have the funds they need to win. Any amount will help, but if you give $100 or more, one of our top supporters — Mike Rydin from Houston — has agreed to donate $100 to multiply your contribution. This is the perfect time to help elect strong conservative leaders and achieve the maximum impact. Peter, let’s bring you up to speed on what’s happening in the Tar Heel State.
Republicans have gone scorched-earth in their efforts to salvage the midterms. Their methods have ranged from rushing through a Trump-ordered racial gerrymander to trying to change vote-by-mail rules just _hours_ before ballots were mailed.
**It’s clear: The GOP will stop at nothing to hold on to power — even if it means undermining our democracy.**

name: Dan Cox
subject: Feel the Momentum!
body:
Maryland is ready for change to bring back common sense. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6ef90e315bec/feel-the-momentum?e=5bb5efcda7)
---
| |
---
| |
# Momentum to victory.
Dear friend,
Today, my wife shared a video of the first day of soccer for our special needs son that moved my heart.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/19wTApdauBV?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
I was traversing the state's I-95 "blue" corridor with your next Lt. Governor Rob Krop, fighting for you.

And I was thinking of our son's future as well.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/HHfg8IK3NcR?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

The momentum we see is strong and growing every day. Like today, when I was again approached spontaneously by Marylanders, including several minorities, young business leaders and managers of six stores, and several retirees - all of whom said in the public setting at the store that they support me and are voting for me because "you must win so we can actually stay here in Maryland, it's getting to be outrageously expensive." This organic support and momentum is real and far stronger than ever before, with a sense of urgency.

One man told me today his 2002 dump truck registration payment today was $1,100.00!!! And then a tire "fee" of $5 a tire on top of inflation and the 6% sales tax. Another business owner told me their electric bill is approaching $50,000!!! Unsustainable. And it is because of Wes Moore's policy decisions such as increasing 338 fees and taxes, closing power plants and having no care to ensure Maryland prospers.

It's so bad, friend, that Wes Moore is planning new taxes next year if he wins re-election. Today, he took credit for balancing the budget while blaming federal authorities for the fact that he has run our state's budget into the ground - and our economy to be the second worst economy in the nation. He blames others, yet our state's huge deficit was first announced under his first year of leadership when President Biden was in office back in 2023-24; his budget director ended up leaving. It was reported then that he had spent Governor Hogan's $5 Billion surplus cash on hand, and had continued to spend and waste taxpayer dollars into the $400 million and then $1 billion range. Now it is approaching $3.3 billion in a structural deficit!

We will right the ship and get Maryland back on track as the great state it is, with lower taxes, cutting fees, suspending the gas tax, bringing power plants online, fiscal responsibility and putting senior citizens first with 100% tax relief on property and pensions/retirement. No senior citizen or retiree should pay tax on Social Security but in Wes Moore's Maryland they must. Yet, no State anywhere near Maryland requires this \- not even the District of Columbia, Washington D.C.

You know we have gone astray by Wes Moore's leadership when we tax seniors worse than California, New York and Massachusetts combined. A Maryland senior living on IRA retirement income can face a substantially higher state-and-local income-tax bill than an identical retiree in California, New York, or Massachusetts, largely because Maryland taxes IRA withdrawals without its pension exclusion and adds county income tax on top of state income tax, plus taxes Social Security which those states do not do!

It's past time for change to renew Maryland. We need your support to run our cable TV ads, streaming TV ads and place our billboards. [Will you chip in today and donate what you can? Now is the moment - next week mail-in and ballot drop off voting begins](https://us.list-manage.com/150sU9J_mX1?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Thank you.

For Maryland,
Dan Cox
Governor nominee

P.S. We are close to launching new TV ads for our campaign - please donate now to help us get those running!

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer.

Patriot,

There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" means.

On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law actually does.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDN9AAwAAAAAAwTs_s85_2uFJNsessCmZjX5xThxbAoOyjcsV3qsyXdajeuKpDTj1oxT-FfbTX8c8CydvqErnEKZBatdq-UUqmD9wlOcE9PPCtyOo42iPA

Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Patriot: it makes it harder for anyone — me included — to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent.

I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; this is just the beginning.

Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General— the one person in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it.

That's not a coincidence, Patriot. That's the system protecting itself.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDN9AAwAAAAAAwTs_s86W1InX4k4G5ZQWWzBDoe6gK1irXX0wjciXww-BdLQSkBClwLfwJE7Rwvh2Gs524Z5hLyJjdID_uCuX5q_xytruPa3k2IwL5g5gA
Patriot, will you make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or $100 today to help keep independent journalists like me in the field?

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDN9AAwAAAAAAwTs_s87B7GEHE-Oh7kxEneyMthI8kNUu8gEIvi604Yl39lRpnWi0KaRytVXL9lgkEvF-tyJiwoWf1ddjIvIYDwXPgWPo_hCZyzoKw0pvQ
Yes — I'll Help Keep Independent Journalists in the Field

I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't — daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding.

Please remind your friends to vote: today is the first day of early voting in Virginia.
Recommended Votes:
-Re-elect John McGuire to Congress
-Bert Mizusawa US Senate
Since January 2025, my team and I have helped negotiate roughly $20 billion in investment into Virginia's Fifth District, creating about 7,000 well-paying jobs. My team and I have returned over $10 million owed by the federal government directly back to the people it belonged to. We passed the Wintergreen Emergency Egress Act, a bill that six previous 5th District congressmen failed to move through a subcommittee for over 25 years. It is now in the Senate, where it passed the full committee unanimously. And I was proud to spearhead the effort, working with Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao, to finally deliver a Navy and Marine Corps ROTC program at Liberty University starting this year, something the university has pursued since 1971.
We also worked personally with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to help get 57 of our constituents home from Israel when ballistic missiles were raining down across the country.
Two hundred fifty years ago, our Founding Fathers built this country on the Bible, and we are fighting to keep that foundation strong. House Republicans have worked with President Trump to strengthen our economy, support American workers, secure our border, rebuild the military, and unleash American energy. | Proud to earn the endorsement on my birthday of the National Federation of Independent Business, the nation's leading voice for small business.
As a 28-year small business owner, I know what it takes to make payroll, deal with regulations, and keep the lights on. That's why I fight every day in Congress to cut red tape, keep energy costs down, and give Main Street the certainty it needs to grow.
My opponent has a very different record. Tom Perriello not only voted for the 2009 cap-and-trade "climate change" bill that would have driven up energy prices on Virginia manufacturers, farmers, and small business owners, he proudly defended that vote. That same big-government climate approach later became the model for the Green New Deal: higher costs and more control from Washington. He also voted for Obamacare "the unaffordable care act" and has repeatedly said he has no regrets, even though it cost him his seat. For many small businesses, that law brought higher health insurance costs and new mandates. Healthcare premiums and deductibles for individuals also continue to rise significantly every year since. He backed the 2009 stimulus that added hundreds of billions in new debt while our district continued to struggle with jobs, and he voted with Nancy Pelosi roughly 90% of the time on the major economic bills of that Congress.
I have a 100% voting record with NFIB because I believe small businesses should keep more of what they earn and compete without Washington stacking the deck against them.
Virginia's small businesses deserve a partner in Congress who has actually lived their challenges, not another politician who keeps voting for more regulations and higher costs. We can't afford Tom Perriello.
Say no thank you, join the team, and vote John McGuire.

clean_body: | | | | == | Early Voting Starts Today | | Please remind your friends to vote: today is the first day of early voting in Virginia. Recommended Votes: -Re-elect John McGuire to Congress -Bert Mizusawa US Senate Since January 2025, my team and I have helped negotiate roughly $20 billion in investment into Virginia's Fifth District, creating about 7,000 well-paying jobs. My team and I have returned over $10 million owed by the federal government directly back to the people it belonged to. We passed the Wintergreen Emergency Egress Act, a bill that six previous 5th District congressmen failed to move through a subcommittee for over 25 years. It is now in the Senate, where it passed the full committee unanimously. And I was proud to spearhead the effort, working with Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao, to finally deliver a Navy and Marine Corps ROTC program at Liberty University starting this year, something the university has pursued since 1971. We also worked personally with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth to help get 57 of our constituents home from Israel when ballistic missiles were raining down across the country. Two hundred fifty years ago, our Founding Fathers built this country on the Bible, and we are fighting to keep that foundation strong. House Republicans have worked with President Trump to strengthen our economy, support American workers, secure our border, rebuild the military, and unleash American energy. We are building 10 miles of wall per day. We delivered the largest investment in rural hospitals by far, $50 billion. We passed the Working Families Tax Cuts (the One Big Beautiful Bill), delivering No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and historic tax relief for seniors with a $6,000 deduction. The Patriot Industries CEO in Louisa County told Kelly Loufler and me that no tax on overtime is clearly working because he sees higher-quality employee cars in the parking lot. And my wife Tracy loves it that we are at a roughly 125-year low in the murder rate across our country. If Democrats win, they will undo all of that. My fellow Virginians, early voting starts today. My opponent touts his woke carbon-credit climate-change agenda, has ties to George Soros-funded open-border policies, and brags about being the deciding vote in the House for Obamacare, the terrible, unaffordable care act. I need you to vote. So mark your calendars. Vote Republican up and down the ballot and let's keep America winning. And if you want a yard sign, want to volunteer, or want to donate, go to mcguireva.com. Thank you, God bless you, and God bless the United States of America! Here is news and some of what we have been up to: How to Lower Fuel Costs | | FYI: The United States is producing more crude oil than ever (record levels in 2025 and expected again in 2026), but refining capacity has declined due to recent plant closures and decades of regulatory barriers by Green New Deal (SCAM) type policies that have prevented construction of major new refineries. I sent a letter to President Trump asking him to consider a state of emergency and to significantly streamline the NEPA permitting process so we can build and expand domestic refining capacity faster. Without adequate refining capacity, even tripling our crude production wouldn't mean lower diesel, gasoline, and other fuel prices for American consumers. | A Heartbreaking Day | | | Tuesday September 16, was a tough, heartbreaking day. My best friend and childhood friend since middle school, George Vassey, lost his fight with cancer. This reality stings like nothing else and is a reminder, make sure we hug our loved ones. Every day is a gift, but not a guarantee. We went through so much together in high school. We were in the Sea Cadets, took karate taught by a Vietnam Green Beret, and shared a love of motorcycles, motorcycle racing, and an interest in serving our country in the military. We famously rode our bicycles from Richmond, Virginia to West Virginia and back. In our spare time we played paintball in the woods with a bunch of Vietnam veterans as part of our preparation to one day serve our country in the US military. In High School, George's mom would make us sloppy Joes while we took turns reading different Psalms. After graduation, I went on to become a Navy SEAL while George became a Navy Corpsman assigned to Marine recon teams. George is survived by his wife Gina and his son George. We've lost several people this year who made a real impact on my life and on so many others to cancer. Please continue to keep Gina and the family in your prayers. Rest easy, brother. George is with our Lord and Savior now. You'll always be remembered. | An Incredible Two Days in Dallas! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | What an incredible two days in Dallas! The first-ever Republican Midterm Convention was pure energy, unity, and America First strength. From the moment we walked into the American Airlines Center in Dallas, you could feel the excitement of thousands of patriots from every state, ready to fight for our country. One of the best parts was running into so many friends, old and new, from all over Virginia including VA 05 and around the country. == | Never Forget Charlie Kirk | | | One year ago, a bright light was senselessly taken from us by pure evil. Charlie Kirk gave people who disagreed with him a real voice and a genuine chance to debate their views at the mic. For that courage, for standing firm in open discussion, he was assassinated. No one in my lifetime has better articulated our pro American, conservative, and Christian values. His wisdom, clarity, and passion will live on through the ages. His legacy and impact on others was mentioned often this week at the republican midterm ￼convention in Dallas. We are praying for his wife Erika and their two young children, who have endured unbelievable criticism while carrying this unimaginable loss. Never forget Charlie Kirk. His light still shines. | Louisa County GOP Committee Meeting | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I recently visited the Louisa County GOP committee meeting. We discussed my reelection, our strong U.S. Senate candidate ==, the terrible amendments being pushed, the the upcoming 5th District GOP Chair Convention on August 14 to elect ==. | == vs. == Football Game | | == | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Had a wonderful time last night at the == vs. == football game with my wife Tracy, my favorite Hokie! Both are great Virginia schools, and it was so much fun catching up with old friends and meeting new ones. I ran into folks from just about every county in Virginia's 5th District. The tailgate was a blast, the atmosphere was fun, and the music was fantastic, especially that epic opening mix of the famous Virginia Tech fight song with "Sandman." The whole night felt like one big party. A special thank you to the == & the Corps of Cadets for letting me do push-ups on the board out on the field after the first touchdown. That was an absolute highlight! == | September 25 GOTV Rally with Congressman Jim Jordan | | Dear Friend, You're invited to a special Get Out the Vote Rally with Congressman John McGuire and special guest Congressman Jim Jordan! Event Details: Friday, September 25th 3:00 - 4:00 P.M. The County Seat Restaurant Powhatan, Virginia Come hear from Congressman John McGuire and Congressman Jim Jordan as we work to keep the House majority and keep Virginia strong. This is a great opportunity to show your support and help get out the vote. Questions or to RSVP to confirm you'll attend. Call Ramona Christian at 434-391-4546 or email mailto:Ramona@McGuireVA.com. We hope to see you there! Thank you, McGuire for Virginia | You're Invited: Fundraising Reception for Congressman John McGuire with Special Guest Jim Jordan | | == | Dear Friend, Mike Kehoe cordially invites you to an Evening Fundraising Reception in honor of Congressman John McGuire, with special guest Congressman Jim Jordan. Event Details: Friday, September 25, 2026 6:00 PM - Sponsor Reception 6:30 PM - General Reception Commonwealth Club 401 W Franklin Street Richmond, VA Contribution Levels: • Co-Chair: $5,000 - 5 reservations to the private Sponsor and General Receptions • Benefactor: $3,500 - 4 reservations • Patron: $1,000 - 3 reservations • Sponsor: $500 - 2 reservations • Attendee: $50 per person - General Reception Please RSVP and for more information contact Gretchen Moss at mailto:Gretchen@gretchenmoss.com or 703-201-7776. We hope you can join us in support of Congressman McGuire. Thank you, == | Lunenburg County Republican Committee | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I recently joined the Lunenburg County Republican Committee at their event in Albemarle County at Trump Winery. We discussed my reelection, our strong U.S. Senate candidate ==, the terrible amendments being pushed, and the upcoming 5th District GOP Chair Convention on August 14 to elect ==. | == | | | I recently stopped by the == meeting where we discussed my reelection, our strong U.S. Senate candidate ==, the terrible amendments being pushed, and the upcoming 5th District GOP Chair Convention on August 14 to elect ==. | Benedictine Football | | | | | | | Stopped by == in Goochland County (Virginia's 5th District) last Saturday to watch the Cadets play and cheer them on. Benedictine's mission is to form Cadets as Christian men of conscience, discipline, and achievement. That mission shows up every day, on the field, in the classroom, and through the leadership program. Parents looking for a school that develops the whole young man, faith, character, academics, and leadership, while surrounding him with a strong brotherhood and competitive athletics will find it here. Benedictine prepares boys to become men of purpose. As part of the Benedictine Schools of Richmond, Cadets also benefit from their close connection with sister school Saint Gertrude High School. The two schools share campus life, traditions, and a broader Catholic community while maintaining their distinct single-sex programs. Go Cadets! | Dr. Oz | | | Recently, == made a few stops in Virginia's 5th District with Congressman John McGuire. We discussed the real challenges facing rural healthcare. We caught up with Brooke, a former SEAL Team PT fitness member who trained my team and I. She appeared on the Dr. Oz Show a few times and went on to win a national weight loss competition back in the day. She ended up losing 160 pounds, remarried, ran a half marathon, and so much more. She credited Dr. Oz and me for helping change her life, a powerful reminder of what's possible when people work together as a team. | Happy Birthday Dad Age 85 | | | | | | | | | | | | | Happy 85th Birthday to my Dad on September 3rd, John Joseph McGuire Jr.! Dad is an Army veteran, father of five, grandfather of 22, and one of the biggest-hearted people I know. We came from humble beginnings, and our family faced some hard times, including my time in foster care. But Dad fought hard to turn his life around and has positively impacted many lives. In one remarkable week, a week we call a week of redemption, in November 2024, the week == was re-elected, my Dad celebrated 41 years sober, my younger brother was promoted to Brigadier General, and I was elected to Congress. My brother and I told Dad: If you hadn't fought so hard to get sober, my brother wouldn't be a general and I wouldn't be a Congressman. His courage changed the course of our family and generations to come. Every family has its ups and downs, but throughout your life, you have always been there for others and put your family first. Even as you face some very difficult health challenges, know we are here for you. We love you more than words could ever express. Happy 85th Birthday, Dad! | Oliver Anthony Concert at Longwood University | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Tracy and I recently spent a special evening together at the Oliver Anthony concert at Longwood University in Farmville, right in the heart of Virginia's 5th Congressional District. Campaigning has kept us apart more than we'd like, which made the evening together even more meaningful. We loved seeing so many friends and neighbors from across the 5th District, catching up with familiar faces, and meeting new ones. Oliver closed the show with his powerful anthem, "Rich Men North of Richmond," the song he released in 2023 that resonated deeply with so many hardworking Americans during the Biden administration. But a powerful moment came after the music because Oliver invited a preacher to share the Gospel, and do by baptisms. Moments like that are a powerful reminder of what matters most: faith, family, community, and serving others. | Congratulations Hung Cao | | to our friend and fellow Navy Veteran Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao for being nominated for Secretary of the Navy. | Happy Anniversary Tracy | | | Happy Anniversary to my beautiful wife, Tracy. She is so much more than my wife. She is an incredible mom to our five amazing children, my best friend, my favorite real estate agent, my favorite artist, my biggest supporter, and the woman I'm so blessed to walk through life with. Her love for the Lord, her deep commitment to her faith and Bible study, and the way she pours herself into our family inspire me every single day. I know I could never work as hard as I do serving our community as the Congressman without her by my side. Her love, encouragement, sacrifice, and quiet strength make it possible for me to do what I do. And what a life we've had together so far. From changing thousands of lives at our company SEAL Team PT, to Spartan Races and marathons, skydiving, earning her motorcycle license, shooting every type of gun, hiking everywhere, knocking out countless push-ups side by side, and every adventure in between, she has always been willing to jump in and experience life with me. Through it all, the best part has always been doing it together. I'm looking forward to many more adventures, memories, laughs, and years with her. Happy Anniversary, Tracy. I am truly blessed to have you in my life. | == | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Had a great time at ==. Lynchburg Arms and Indoor Range has been a staple in the local firearms and shooting community since 2010. Got to talk with folks about the upcoming election and what's at stake. Appreciate everyone who came out and shared their thoughts. | Fluvanna County GOP Committee | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I had the pleasure of speaking with the == at the Fluvanna County GOP Committee. Thank you to Chairman Barbara Haines allowing me to address your team. We discussed the work being done in Washington and right here at home, covering a wide range of issues important to the 5th District. We also discussed signing up to be a delegate now so you can vote for == at the convention on November 14th. | Fluvanna High football | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | For football fans, this is a great time of the year. At the Fluvanna High football game, the Flucos took care of business and beat Spotsylvania 44-36 in a fun, high-scoring one. Great energy in the stands, even more on the field. Shook a ton of hands and enjoyed speaking with parents and coaches. | Nelson County GOP Committee | | | I had the pleasure of speaking with the Nelson County GOP Committee. Thank you to Chairman Michael Hevener for the invitation and for your continued support. We discussed the work being done in Washington and right here at home, covering a wide range of issues important to the 5th District. I especially enjoyed the one-on-one conversations about the district and the upcoming midterms. | Monument Terrace in Lynchburg | | | Virginia is home to more than 600,000 veterans, ranking among the highest concentrations of veterans per capita in the entire United States. I spoke to a crowd of veterans at Monument Terrace in Lynchburg, the historic downtown memorial that has long stood as a gathering place for those who served. I thanked these men and women for their service and sacrifice. We discussed the work being done in Washington and right here at home to support our veterans, our military, and hard-working Americans in Virginia's 5th District and across our nation. | Flock Cameras | | | == Football Season Opener | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Had an absolute blast at the == season opener with my wife Tracy! New quarterback Beau Pribula looked sharp in his debut as the Hoos rolled past NC State 34-8. Beau Pribula wears #7 for Virginia. Spent the whole game walking around Scott Stadium talking with fans and shaking hands, the energy was electric. Wahoowa! Way to go Hoos! What a way to start the season. Did you know UVA is right here in Virginia's 5th Congressional District? == | Division II Majors State Champions | | | | | | | | | In Buckingham County I had the chance to speak with Virginia's 2026 DYB Division II Majors State Champions. Huge congratulations to these young athletes on their hard-earned title. Just as important, thank you to the parents, coaches, teachers, and staff who invest so much in preparing our young people not just for the game, but for life. We are proud of you! | Early Morning Lynchburg | | | Trump Winery with the Women of the Constitution | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | We are working hard to get out the vote all over the district. My wife Tracy and I were in Albemarle County at the incredibly beautiful Trump Winery with the Women of the Constitution, Charlottesville. Thank you for allowing == and me to speak about the midterms, the amendments, and the November 14th 5th District GOP Chair Convention. | Navy and Marine ROTC Liberty University | | == It really is amazing what we can achieve when we put God first, set our differences aside, treat people with respect, and work as a team. I've been told Liberty University wanted a Navy and Marine ROTC program since they were founded in 1971. Finally, we are making that happen. You can stand firm on conservative values and still get things done. In the General Assembly, my team and I solved problems others said couldn't be solved, and we passed bills every year with every Republican and every Democrat voting yes. Now in Congress, we're doing the same thing: solving problems and passing bills with bipartisan support. Thank you ==, ==, ==, and the == for helping us make this long awaited goal a reality. I'm looking forward to delivering this signed agreement to Liberty University Friday! == | | National Federation of Independent Business | | | Proud to earn the endorsement on my birthday of the National Federation of Independent Business, the nation's leading voice for small business. As a 28-year small business owner, I know what it takes to make payroll, deal with regulations, and keep the lights on. That's why I fight every day in Congress to cut red tape, keep energy costs down, and give Main Street the certainty it needs to grow. My opponent has a very different record. Tom Perriello not only voted for the 2009 cap-and-trade "climate change" bill that would have driven up energy prices on Virginia manufacturers, farmers, and small business owners, he proudly defended that vote. That same big-government climate approach later became the model for the Green New Deal: higher costs and more control from Washington. He also voted for Obamacare "the unaffordable care act" and has repeatedly said he has no regrets, even though it cost him his seat. For many small businesses, that law brought higher health insurance costs and new mandates. Healthcare premiums and deductibles for individuals also continue to rise significantly every year since. He backed the 2009 stimulus that added hundreds of billions in new debt while our district continued to struggle with jobs, and he voted with Nancy Pelosi roughly 90% of the time on the major economic bills of that Congress. I have a 100% voting record with NFIB because I believe small businesses should keep more of what they earn and compete without Washington stacking the deck against them. Virginia's small businesses deserve a partner in Congress who has actually lived their challenges, not another politician who keeps voting for more regulations and higher costs. We can't afford Tom Perriello. Say no thank you, join the team, and vote John McGuire. | Vote Ramona Christian | | | I am asking Republicans across the Virginia 5th Congressional District to support Ramona Christian for our next Fifth District Chair. This is Vivek Ramaswamy.
I hoped to email you on a lighter note, but with the radical Left now targeting my home state of Ohio, I have no choice.
In 2024, the American people delivered a clear mandate. We won the White House, the Senate, and the House. [We dealt a massive blow to the unholy alliance of the DC Swamp, the Liberal Media, and the Radical Left.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
But they won’t just disappear because of one election. They haven't given up on their plan to destroy our country.
[Right now, they are pouring resources into Ohio to install their puppet, Amy Acton, as Governor.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-9WJoIi2CiC6_gUwnGyrjw) They want to turn my home state into a blue fortress to sabotage President Trump and our national revival.
We will never forget what these radicals did last time they were in power:
– Arrested the leader of the Republican Party– Removed Trump from the ballot in key states– Raided Mar-a-Lago with armed agents– Censored Conservative voices– Spied on Catholic worshippers– Gutted election integrity measures– Peddled the Russia Hoax for years – Threw open our border to illegals– Abandoned Americans in Afghanistan– Caved to the Chinese Communist Party– Moved to pack the Supreme Court– Forced propaganda into classrooms
And the list goes on and on and on! Never before in the history of the world has a truly great country fallen so far from grace in such a short time.
If Amy Acton wins in Ohio, she will use the Governor's office to implement the same Biden-Harris failures that we just fought so hard to defeat.
[That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, humbly asking you to chip in to my must-win campaign before the end of the day.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._-HF4Mr8A)
Moments like this separate the strong from the weak. And make no mistake – the future of our country hangs in the balance.
[I’m asking for 100% participation from every strong American Patriot reading this.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
[If that’s you, we need your help – whether you live in Ohio or not – for the sake of the country. It’s the only way we win.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._IR6e6f5fA8JPHiog)
If you can’t afford to pitch in $100 or $50 right now, I understand completely. Any amount you can spare, will still go a long way in the fight for what we believe in. [I only ask that everyone contributes SOMETHING.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._GpyUsPAuUdZ3ofQw)

body:
Rush a small donation and help me keep asking the questions nobody else will!

Hey Peter, Tim Burchett here.
I’ve got a reputation in Congress for asking questions folks in Washington would rather dodge.
Not the kind that gets you on TV. Not the kind that makes the evening news.
Questions like:
"Where exactly did that $40 billion go?"
"Why does this bill have 3,000 pages if there are only 100 important things in it?"
"Can someone explain to me why we keep funding programs that don't work?"
My colleagues look at me like I've got two heads sometimes. I don't care.
[Because those are YOUR questions.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._Gu2Q)
And if you want a Congressman to sit quietly and clap like a trained seal while they burn through your money, then y’all definitely picked the wrong fella.
Problem is, the people getting rich off this mess would love to send me packing.
They’ve got lobbyists, PAC cash, and enough slick-haired consultants to fill a Nashville hotel ballroom.
I’ve got grassroots patriots like you, Peter.
[And if you’re still with me, rush a small donation and help me keep asking the questions nobody else will:](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-fJRWvuA)

My opponent, Eli Savit, has put residents in harm's way as Washtenaw County's Prosecutor. He's pushed no cash bail, legalized prostitution and drugs, and is admittedly under-charging illegal immigrants if it will keep them safe from deportation.
And some of his decisions have led to violence. He gave a repeat sex offender a slap on the wrist. The criminal went on to sexually assault and murder a woman.
He also allowed a criminal who hog-tied and suffocated a woman off with probation. Months later, this guy carjacked a mom and shot her in front of her child in Oakland County.

## Hackers Hit Galveston-Bound Oil Tanker
A team of Coast Guard and FBI agents [boarded a supertanker](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CwQhJ8GZ4ygh8EQOPgTZ_unF1ptaGw0jFlB73j37U--e4TLSqpSqb769bF8YC752P7HF038nepy0NkLMVNbdgxPan3PXHNhPJ7UWu095QUUWKm81G7BwPlNi8EhTquKXg806dH5Efxd2WGfnEpWJ5XQ-2C8tlF5E40Fn8ZxVV4PebrqlNdOa6WNvVkFj4BreoAJerUgjKKYubYb78T0jT2Vn_qmdgv1NZRpZ_7s4v6fgFnAfJ7n7bnXr8sUMGPjHAoJmC8yAXOpAYuAOVTsLLcvbFHm402d84acj03mhkfGQ4aflRoyY3jKv_hyw3Il6yFgBveQ0T4SrAqlM_oujUqXiiRJoSMiiO7uhjbFzzOXkrsdhVHbC3P5M53_9fL3BL8DAAD__5YxlqA) bound for Galveston last month after hackers broke into the ship's computer network and knocked out its communications for about 30 hours. The _VL Prosperity_ left Egypt on Aug. 1, hauling crude oil for Galveston, and [slowed near the Strait of Gibraltar](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAUhE-DOyxg_VtQpHG3aVNaD3jYaLFZwct6ffvIyRHSjTTSaL7v6z7fIcSwL5-woaa3T_OOR4lIhHlewT4wlzVQCpFgf2DOqRQfZiVUx8XI5TCDpfDCuYHKaSPcKCvUsh_GXo030VWrtqa3cmhBoZDY2XaEZoShF43xHlvTV0Ffc2KUg5RCNl3dCdVaML5VjZWmU6wR6AKlXNOKhG8oPp7phbm2aauiXomehd0-mJqYmo7jqK0pF8fVMzVdkanJJijEl2_IjnsTuEmQHTqOO-bl5H-AhdvTYAYisI_CYTv5ksFE5CHDztRUZe2eR4gxlK5njVg2CPH3CP1X4EurnwAAAP__6yWJGw) around the time of the attack. The Liberian-flagged tanker is 1,093 feet and can carry roughly 2.3 million barrels. Iranian state media claimed the hackers reached the ship's propulsion, navigation, and cargo systems. U.S. officials haven't confirmed that, but Rear Adm. Amy Grable, who leads Coast Guard Cyber Command, said the team that [climbed aboard on Aug. 21](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O2zAQRk9DdTTI0Y_FgkUadZs2pTAkR9LAtLggx9717QMnR9j6Az689_58rB_Imc_9N97Jy_dW1pO-WiYRquuB8Ua1HSyFs-B5o1pLaxuvYGDSxmk7rxiFn7QO2CUfTHK2I2-vs7uC683UHX4M1MdxwH7AKY0zuCnNvZsBrg6Ts7Zj_74zzs7WGjtMl8nAGDFsIwzRhgnUYCixlHqRg4S-sW35VZ5UL7Hcu-wPkc-m-l8KFgULhmj796JgaVLqS8ESCzbR-wNr0ltgzeeTmvCOwueuQRfO-r9g06E8zqQfTR8sOr4CVRTBeGu6lUeN1BQs1s397PpBwdJVnz6_OGdu01UNZr8j539g8tOgTw9_AwAA__-P-ovi) found malicious cyber activity. Investigators are still weighing whether Iran or another foreign actor hit the two U.S.-bound tankers. "_Of course we're worried about a collision, an explosion_ ," Grable said, urging ships at sea to request cybersecurity help.

Norman and Ker'Sean Ramey believed [cocaine was stashed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-SgyAQh59GOxxYFaSguMYu117pEFzjTlAysIne298kr3D97898389luniKtN--_YaOzyVNOx4lIjPmafXhjrmsxIki-_2OOadSFppAghbSCjVMPjC9cOp8PburnK2q0SkzWAO2lbpeXev90ILUAK3qlTWtCQENWmu1GXTf1-Tec9KqQSmpOt1oCX3w16WHLqirhqqTOBOn3PCKjKcvS_xNL8xNSFsd3cr8KFX7VcFYwXgcR7OkE_SanoXT_g5VML65Khg_dVGQBZ4YnoyC9s0zCpCyF5zpEVFszzxjrrObHwfFSEWbqpO3zVP8XPJ_Vb0c_AUAAP__sY5_Eg) in the house and planned to steal it, court records show, but they never found drugs. The VL Prosperity left Egypt on Aug. 1, hauling crude oil for Galveston, and around the time of the attack. The Liberian-flagged tanker is 1,093 feet and can carry roughly 2.3 million barrels. Iranian state media claimed the hackers reached the ship's propulsion, navigation, and cargo systems. U.S. officials haven't confirmed that, but Rear Adm. Amy Grable, who leads Coast Guard Cyber Command, said the team that found malicious cyber activity. Investigators are still weighing whether Iran or another foreign actor hit the two U.S.-bound tankers. "Of course we're worried about a collision, an explosion ," Grable said, urging ships at sea to request cybersecurity help. Texas Executes Man for Triple Murder Texas , 40, by lethal injection Wednesday at the Huntsville penitentiary for the 2005 shooting deaths of three people inside a neighbor's home in Edna. It's the state's fifth execution this year. Norman and Ker'Sean Ramey believed in the house and planned to steal it, court records show, but they never found drugs. They shot Samuel Roberts, 24, Tiffani Peacock, 18, and Celso Lopez, 38, inside the home. Norman was arrested five months later, trying to cross into the United States from Mexico. He pleaded guilty to capital murder, leaving a jury to decide his sentence. The U.S. Supreme Court declined to halt the execution. Asked for any last words, Norman shook his head, then nodded toward a window where a sister, two of his children, and a friend watched. He was Ramey is scheduled to die next week. Mammoth Hunter Joins Texas Billionaires The Dallas entrepreneur trying to bring the woolly mammoth back from extinction just list of America's richest people. Ben Lamm, 44, founder and CEO of Colossal Biosciences, debuted at No. 302 with an estimated $5.7 billion, to make the list. His fortune rests on efforts to de-extinct the mammoth, the Tasmanian tiger, and the dodo. The wealth required to make the top 400 climbed to a record $4.4 billion from $3.8 billion last year. name: Roy Cooper
subject: re: President Trump's super PAC
body:
We cannot afford to lose any more ground.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&source=&t=1&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr) | | | |
---
Peter, I have bad news to share.
President Trump and his super PAC are pouring millions into North Carolina to defeat me, keep this battleground seat in his hands and defend the Republican Senate majority.
Trump has been sitting on his massive war chest for months now – reserving it for the most opportune moment – and with a recent poll showing me statistically tied with his handpicked candidate, **Trump is rushing in a surge of MAGA cash to help him take the lead.**
[**_That’s because this race will decide Senate control. So please, Peter, if you care about flipping North Carolina and taking back the Senate for Democrats, I need you to chip in $5 or even just a few bucks to my campaign today. Can I count on you?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&amount=5&t=8&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&amount=5&t=9&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&amount=25&t=10&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&amount=50&t=11&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&t=12&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
---
It’s not surprising that Trump is spending big in North Carolina. The GOP has been panicking ever since experts said this was the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
The momentum was on our side, and we were growing stronger by the day.
However, then dark-money super PACs started pouring in _millions._ They’re at over $100 million and counting – all to smear me with attack ads and spread blatant lies about me and this election.
**Now, we’re getting outspent and drowned out on the airwaves, and my narrow polling lead has shrunk to a virtual tie. We’re about to face millions more in dark money, thanks to President Trump, and we cannot afford to lose any more ground.**
[**_Please, Peter, I need your urgent help to fight back. Will you make a well-timed donation of $5 so I can respond to the GOP’s attacks, win in North Carolina and flip the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&amount=5&t=13&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
Every dollar counts, and every contribution means the world to me. Thank you.
Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1381&t=2&akid=3568%2E124072%2E6AM4Jr)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Now I'm the Republican nominee in a seat Democrats desperately want to flip, and they're prepared to spend whatever it takes to stop me.

clean_body: Please read this from beginning to end.| | | Peter, I urgently need to get in touch with you, because my situation just became more serious. My name is Captain Mike Bouchard. I'm a U.S. Army paratrooper, a Bronze Star recipient, and a third-generation Michigander running for Congress in Michigan's 10th District. I served as an infantry officer in the 101st Airborne and did intelligence work for the 82nd. I've served on our southern border. And I spent nine months deployed to Iraq. Twelve days after I came home, I launched this campaign. Now I'm the Republican nominee in a seat Democrats desperately want to flip, and they're prepared to spend whatever it takes to stop me. They can't stand that a young combat veteran who believes in faith, family, and country is standing between them and the House majority. I'll be straight with you. Asking for help doesn't come naturally to a soldier. But I can't win this mission alone. I'm humbly asking you to. You have my word as a soldier: I will never stop fighting for you. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139431992/647369796/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFhNGRjNjdkLTU4YjMtZjExMS1hNmE3LTAwMjI0ODJhOWE4ZCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=3p9GbO1W_VcCYnDsksDi5TrLzAUAcFy7-aEYPakT0I4=&emci=0c29f417-d5b2-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=aa4dc67d-58b3-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=8431045)

We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. This exact situation happened in Wisconsin last year when Elon Musk dumped $20 million to influence one single supreme court race. It’s happening again in Ohio right now. **A billionaire, from Pennsylvania no less, has already spent ten figures and counting to support former-DOGE boss Vivek Ramaswamy in the governor’s race.** That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. _Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio?_ Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. That's why we’ve endorsed Democracy Defender candidates in these races. [**We need your help to ensure no one gets away with buying their way into power. We can’t compete with million-dollar checks, but grassroots support adds up fast. clean_body: The power of the people, not the billionaires, must be heard in November. | We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. This exact situation happened in Wisconsin last year when Elon Musk dumped $20 million to influence one single supreme court race. It’s happening again in Ohio right now. A billionaire, from Pennsylvania no less, has already spent ten figures and counting to support former-DOGE boss Vivek Ramaswamy in the governor’s race. That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio? Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. That's why we’ve endorsed Democracy Defender candidates in these races. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = The good news is that we know voters can’t stand it when the powerful elite try to purchase a political race. That helped us defeat Elon Musk in Wisconsin last year. It’s no accident that the right-wing billionaires are targeting the races that will have the most impact on the future fights over democracy. The NDRC has identified over 250 critical elections, and we’re doing everything we can to elect Democracy Defenders in as many of these races as possible. We can win this critical election even if we're outspent, but we can't let Amy Acton get drowned out completely. = Thank you, National Democratic Redistricting Committee = = | | Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- National Democratic Redistricting Committee 712 H St NE, #25 Washington, DC 20002 United States if you'd like to receive fewer emails from the NDRC. | | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?

Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

That's why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** --to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.

**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1q3DAUhZ9G3tlIVx7_LLwo1QwUmpSSRZdGvrpjXyJLwpIT8vYlJfMC3X4HvsPh_Hmanyx7Duuz3WninGcX3Vw2Dq_oyR7-wwaXE9nXdy4bziChq-VYq2G2WPiN5tZWbrqAGu5DRZPqh7HXWiqotqlderrcB7mMLSw40sVpRLIjKnUfFg0VT58-OapBgdRaNot1LXaAXTeovu1G0cozOVuo4ZDZUcYYU4qeC2Nu4rFWftpKSVnobwJuAm4c7rHZ2PvsrKeG3Cng5uPKWB8blXgw1rmc7qNeT3Yk9C2j0EZC38tnCS38vBrzy1yv3wV0Z9nnHM8DSWiTjpgTYeGwfkU7OT53oQ3tlv0XRLsny2sQ2vyrfeAYCoUitPnd1z9eXurH8uqYXHpn7zl3vWjl-ulqMO5V-d8_3ib4GwAA__9e5JvN)

Inside, you'll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart

* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals

* Think more clearly before reacting

* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that's becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly --and speak with confidence.**

And it's not just theory (although there's a lot of that in the guide)!

These are practical tools you can start using right away...in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.

**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.**

And, if you want to go deeper, you can continue learning in Hillsdale College's full FREE online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric."**

Trust me, the guide becomes even more helpful when you see these ideas explained by a Hillsdale faculty member in the full course.

**So, download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide now:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1q3DAUhZ9G3tlIVx7_LLwo1QwUmpSSRZdGvrpjXyJLwpIT8vYlJfMC3X4HvsPh_Hmanyx7Duuz3WninGcX3Vw2Dq_oyR7-wwaXE9nXdy4bziChq-VYq2G2WPiN5tZWbrqAGu5DRZPqh7HXWiqotqlderrcB7mMLSw40sVpRLIjKnUfFg0VT58-OapBgdRaNot1LXaAXTeovu1G0cozOVuo4ZDZUcYYU4qeC2Nu4rFWftpKSVnobwJuAm4c7rHZ2PvsrKeG3Cng5uPKWB8blXgw1rmc7qNeT3Yk9C2j0EZC38tnCS38vBrzy1yv3wV0Z9nnHM8DSWiTjpgTYeGwfkU7OT53oQ3tlv0XRLsny2sQ2vyrfeAYCoUitPnd1z9eXurH8uqYXHpn7zl3vWjl-ulqMO5V-d8_3ib4GwAA__9e5JvN)

It's our gift to you. Part of our educational mission is to help more and more people understand what's true and communicate it clearly.

We hope you find it helpful.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

Joining us is Isaac Botkin founder of T.REX ARMS a holster manufacturing company located in Tennessee. T.REX ARMS is a 6th Commandment & 2nd Amendment company based in Middle Tennessee. They are dedicated to providing quality equipment to citizens who want to protect their life, family, community, and country. Fellow Conservative: In 1991, the mob came for Clarence Thomas. They smeared him. They tried to destroy his name, his reputation, and his honor. As Justice Thomas himself has put it, critics in Washington _"don't bomb you, necessarily, but they bomb your reputation or your good name or your honor."_ **He refused to cave.** And because he did, he became one of the four giants of the modern Supreme Court — alongside Justices Scalia, Alito, and Rehnquist. Senator Ted Cruz has just released a remarkable new book: _**Going Further: The Incomparable Clarence Thomas**_ , built on exclusive interviews with the Justice himself.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=619534cee85b437e83b9823f4ab3d77c&_e=LNutUvEeFI1OXaGdwyL8BdhLcjte8DOXQNXkj1xqJBcKvWfgfUkB5_6-8pXZ4gEadm_UYmF0V99n7TdAISCzCrFQGDjY28d2ImwcpknDgLRs4cYRMuQ-P9Nz-z0RuB9PuMembVCVNTbMz64ouB9g25jygw8-oB0Oqj2MeWgjW3oa6njx7x71BZyVMnJOhdPXcXg5ntgKnCkpThL1UMfzwYHCrMqCA5M_A1mXAKhTBUHCXnY429fQfghR9AVHiT5HmfBOIxOLdfSLdjuhtqlMP8Sl6C9imEGfVG1Ar1Db98gqjivdAQxb5YWjUkgj-EIhwsDwxA_Be42KdJvWqYUSZgyQCneZLUYUvWNJbTRzraiPW_6BRNlUuHMdE7touR0TNt8f-RJE_jnuq7am_Ol0_A%3D%3D)

**Clarence Thomas only reached the Supreme Court because the Senate confirmed him by just two votes.**

Presidents nominate judges. But the Senate confirms them. Every originalist on the bench, and every one we hope to see there, depends on having conservative senators willing to fight. When we lose the Senate, we lose the courts. It's that simple.

subject: Less Than One Week: Join Kennedy Democrats in Doylestown on September 24
body:
We’re less than one week away from the Kennedy Democrats’ September 24 reception at the Doylestown home of our Co-Founder Scott Wallace and Christy Wallace.| | | |
---
**Less Than One Week: Join Kennedy Democrats in Doylestown on September 24!**
---
| | | |
---
Friends - We’re less than one week away from the Kennedy Democrats’ September 24 reception at the Doylestown home of our Co-Founder Scott Wallace and Christy Wallace.We’re looking forward to bringing together friends, supporters, and Kennedy Democrats-endorsed candidates from across Pennsylvania for a special evening ahead of the November elections. This is a chance to spend time with our candidates, reconnect with friends from across the Commonwealth, and meet others in the Kennedy Democrats community.I’m especially grateful to Scott and Christy for opening their home to us and helping bring this group together.The reception is less than one week away, and I hope you can join us. Please reserve your spot with the RSVP link below.The full invitation and event details are included below.Looking forward to seeing you in Doylestown. -Patrick

What do you do when your congressman has represented your district for 7 years without ever hosting a real town hall?
You host 7 of them yourself.
**Over the next few weeks, we 're hosting town halls in every corner of our part of Pennsylvania. [Find one near you and register here.](https://substack.com/redirect/e8c563ee-7bf4-4524-9fc2-08580e6a9810?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

These town halls give us a place to do that - something we've gone without for far too long.
**They 're extremely important, but they aren't cheap. We need all the help we can get to fund them and still have a strong showing when our end-of-quarter deadline hits in two weeks.**

This critical Task Force is already hunting down fraud, waste, and abuse involving taxpayer-funded programs. We want to put another form of government waste squarely on the Vice-President’s radar: the waste, abuse, and taxpayer costs caused by the federal workforce practices addressed in YOUR SURVEY.Your participation is of the utmost importance. Do you believe it’s acceptable that only 6% of federal employees show up in person for a full work week. And if you remove security guards, janitors, facilities and maintenance personnel, the number drops to 1%.Did you know that in addition to 15 cabinet departments, there are over 2,000 federal agencies? Were you aware that leasing and maintenance costs for federal office buildings costs $15.7 billion per year?Or that the occupancy of these buildings is 12% on average?What about the fact that it’s nearly impossible to fire a federal employee? These are the topics covered in part one of the And if you think these questions are infuriating, just wait until you hear what makes up part two of the survey. You see, part two is concerned with the actions of those government employees who actually do show up for work, but who spend every hour of the day plotting to undermine the will of duly elected presidents and ignore duly passed legislation. In other words, the radical deep-state. These are the bureaucrats who’ve burrowed deep into the federal government (often they served as political appointees in a leftwing administration, but refuse to leave after that administration ends, becoming, instead, career “civil servant”).CIA. FBI. National Security Council. State Department. Pentagon. Hostile agents at the highest levels of these departments spent four years leaking, lying, and unleashing lawfare against the first Trump Administration.Shouldn’t the people we elect to run the government actually run the government?Shouldn’t members of the executive branch work in good faith to advance the vision and policies of the head of the executive branch?Shouldn’t any bureaucrat who can’t respect the U.S. Constitution leave government service?Shouldn’t it be an enormous “red flag” that Kamala Harris won 93% of the vote in Washington DC and the fact that roughly 95% of campaign contributions by government bureaucrats go to Democrats? You and I both know that the Constitution of the United States grants no power to unelected federal bureaucrats. Yet these individuals have enormous power and zero accountability.It’s bad enough you and I are being ripped off financially (covered in part one of what’s worse is the reality that our votes and our constitutional republic are being ripped off and wholly undermined by these unions (part two of your survey). In short, this is an attack on the very foundations of our country. It’s part of the Marxist playbook that is destroying America... one that I’m intimately familiar with... because the founder of the David Horowitz Freedom Center helped to write and execute it when he was a member of the radical Left movement in the 1960’s and 1970’s. He knew from first-hand experience how Marxist radicals sought to infiltrate every facet of American life...Schools. Churches. The military. Unions. Businesses. The media. Hollywood. And, yes, the federal bureaucracy. Now, I’m working to expose the TRUTH about the radical Left to a new generation that is being fooled. At the Freedom Center we use the Left’s tactics against them – tactics like those outlined in Saul Alinsky’s “Rules for Radicals” ... in other words we fight fire with fire.Today, I’m asking you to join the Freedom Center in exposing the threat posed by government unions to the mandate delivered by American voters in 2024.Your NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS is the key to reaffirming this mandate—in this critical election season—by demonstrating the consensus that exists to remove the obstructionist deep-state. The Freedom Center is spearheading this movement. It is vitally important that we circulate 1 million of these surveys, so there can be no doubt where our country stands on this issue. Because if the threat of government unions is not broken, banned, and outlawed while conservatives hold power... then it never will be.As I mentioned, the results of this survey will be reported to Vice-President JD Vance, the Chairman of the Task Force to Eliminate Fraud. His Task Force has already gone after fraud and waste involving government benefits, loans, contracts, healthcare programs, and student aid.This survey asks that the concerns Americans raise about waste and accountability in the federal workforce receive this attention, too! The Vice-President has already PROVEN we can take on fraud and waste by: Suspending 870,000 borrowers tied to an estimated $39 BILLION in suspected COVID-era loan fraud from receiving future loans and other SBA assistance. Identifying nearly $230 BILLION in fraud and stopping $56 BILLION in fraudulent payments , per a White House report. Uncovering $6.3 BILLION in suspected fraudulent government contracts and launching an investigation into those contracts. Cracking down on healthcare fraud — including suspending 447 hospices and 23 home-health agencies in Los Angeles associated with an estimated $600 MILLION in suspected fraud. Blocking $60 MILLION in suspected student-aid fraud through new identity-verification safeguards. Helping drive hundreds of federal enforcement actions against alleged fraud schemes involving taxpayer-funded programs across the country. And that’s why I’m also asking you to make a one-time gift of $35 when you do. It’s going to take an enormous grassroots effort to circulate, collect, tabulate, and forward the results of these surveys to the Vice-President and the Task Force to Eliminate Fraud.$8.95 is the cost to cover just your survey—I hope you’ll give at least that amount. That said, if you can send a larger contribution – $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000, or more – it will supercharge this campaign. I want you to know that the Freedom Center will maximize every dollar you contribute. We’ve had “woke” corporations and financial institutions conspire to “de-bank” and “deplatform” us before: They got MasterCard to shut off our online fundraising and credit card processing (we got it turned back on). We had to find a new bank after the local bank we’ve been at for years suddenly closed our accounts. The hotel we’ve held our annual fundraising conference at for the last 20 years abruptly declined to renew our contract. A divided federal appeals court on Friday, Sept. 4, 2026, upheld the dismissal of a lead-contamination lawsuit brought by Jackson, Mississippi residents. -- Bloomberg Law
JACKSON, Miss. -- The U.S. Constitution does not guarantee Americans clean drinking water -- nor even a right to accurate information from public officials during a public-health crisis. That is the blunt conclusion of a 10-5 ruling issued Friday by the full Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals (covers federal appeals from district courts in three states: Texas, Louisiana, and Mississippi**)** , as first reported by Bloomberg's Jacqueline Thomsen.
The decision in Sterling v. City of Jackson affirms dismissal of a 2022 class action brought by residents who say the city's chronically failing water system delivered lead-contaminated tap water to their homes while officials assured them it was safe to drink. Lead plaintiff Priscilla Sterling, a longtime Jackson school teacher, says several of her children were diagnosed with lead poisoning; the suit sought to represent nearly all residents of Hinds County.
The plaintiffs argued that city and state officials violated the 14th Amendment's due process guarantee both by allowing lead into the municipal supply and by falsely telling residents the water was safe. The en banc majority disagreed, holding that there is no cognizable substantive-due-process right to uncontaminated water and no constitutional right to truthful statements from officials -- even in a drinking-water emergency. Water quality, the judges reasoned, is the business of statutes and regulators -- the Safe Drinking Water Act, EPA oversight, and the Mississippi State Department of Health -- not the federal courts.
Five judges dissented, pointing to what the majority conceded: ingesting lead causes serious, lasting harm. An earlier Fifth Circuit panel had allowed the residents' "state-created danger" claim to proceed in 2025 before the full court vacated that opinion and took the case en banc.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/245b5788-4f3c-48c1-afc3-7f647e6dedb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The ruling lands amid Jackson's years-long water emergency -- decades of underinvestment, repeated boil-water notices, and the near-total system collapse after flooding in 2022. It echoes Flint, Michigan, where residents likewise discovered that lead in tap water carried no federal constitutional remedy. It also fits a broader pattern: the Supreme Court narrowed Clean Water Act protections in its 2023 *Sackett* decision, the Iowa Supreme Court rejected a public-trust challenge to Raccoon River pollution in 2021, and Florida appellate courts have twice struck down voter-approved local clean-water measures as beyond local power.
What's left for residents who get sick? Attorneys for the plaintiffs can seek Supreme Court review, though the high court has never recognized an environmental right in the Constitution. Advocates point instead to the levers the ruling leaves untouched: Congress, EPA enforcement, and state constitutions -- Montana and Pennsylvania among them -- that explicitly protect the right to clean water.
For now, the Fifth Circuit's message is unambiguous: in America, clean water is a policy choice, not a constitutional promise.
Sources: Bloomberg (Sept. 4, 2026); Bloomberg Law; Fifth Circuit en banc opinion, Sterling v. City of Jackson, No. 24-60370; Yahoo News; Magnolia Tribune; FindLaw; Food & Water Watch (Iowa); Florida Phoenix.

The Constitution Doesn't Guarantee Clean Drinking Water | | | Sep 18 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- A divided federal appeals court on Friday, Sept. 4, 2026, upheld the dismissal of a lead-contamination lawsuit brought by Jackson, Mississippi residents. -- Bloomberg Law JACKSON, Miss. -- The U.S. Constitution does not guarantee Americans clean drinking water -- nor even a right to accurate information from public officials during a public-health crisis. That is the blunt conclusion of a 10-5 ruling issued Friday by the full Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals (covers federal appeals from district courts in three states: Texas, Louisiana, and Mississippi) , as first reported by Bloomberg's Jacqueline Thomsen. The decision in Sterling v. City of Jackson affirms dismissal of a 2022 class action brought by residents who say the city's chronically failing water system delivered lead-contaminated tap water to their homes while officials assured them it was safe to drink. Lead plaintiff Priscilla Sterling, a longtime Jackson school teacher, says several of her children were diagnosed with lead poisoning; the suit sought to represent nearly all residents of Hinds County. The plaintiffs argued that city and state officials violated the 14th Amendment's due process guarantee both by allowing lead into the municipal supply and by falsely telling residents the water was safe. The en banc majority disagreed, holding that there is no cognizable substantive-due-process right to uncontaminated water and no constitutional right to truthful statements from officials -- even in a drinking-water emergency. Water quality, the judges reasoned, is the business of statutes and regulators -- the Safe Drinking Water Act, EPA oversight, and the Mississippi State Department of Health -- not the federal courts. Five judges dissented, pointing to what the majority conceded: ingesting lead causes serious, lasting harm. An earlier Fifth Circuit panel had allowed the residents' "state-created danger" claim to proceed in 2025 before the full court vacated that opinion and took the case en banc. | | ---|---|--- The ruling lands amid Jackson's years-long water emergency -- decades of underinvestment, repeated boil-water notices, and the near-total system collapse after flooding in 2022. It echoes Flint, Michigan, where residents likewise discovered that lead in tap water carried no federal constitutional remedy. It also fits a broader pattern: the Supreme Court narrowed Clean Water Act protections in its 2023 Sackett decision, the Iowa Supreme Court rejected a public-trust challenge to Raccoon River pollution in 2021, and Florida appellate courts have twice struck down voter-approved local clean-water measures as beyond local power. What's left for residents who get sick? Attorneys for the plaintiffs can seek Supreme Court review, though the high court has never recognized an environmental right in the Constitution. Advocates point instead to the levers the ruling leaves untouched: Congress, EPA enforcement, and state constitutions -- Montana and Pennsylvania among them -- that explicitly protect the right to clean water. For now, the Fifth Circuit's message is unambiguous: in America, clean water is a policy choice, not a constitutional promise. Sources: Bloomberg (Sept. 4, 2026); Bloomberg Law; Fifth Circuit en banc opinion, Sterling v. City of Jackson, No. 24-60370; Yahoo News; Magnolia Tribune; FindLaw; Food & Water Watch (Iowa); Florida Phoenix. Thanks for reading! This post is public so feel free to share it. Meet Mark Harris:
**Mark Harris is a father, grandfather, pastor, and now a sitting member of Congress who has spent his life in service to his faith, his family, and the people of North Carolina.

Born and raised in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, and a graduate of R.J. Reynolds High School, Mark earned a Bachelor of Science in Political Science from Appalachian State University. Not long before marrying his college sweetheart, Beth, he felt a calling to ministry, going on to earn his Master of Divinity and Doctor of Ministry in Christian Leadership from Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary.

Mark spent decades in pastoral ministry across North Carolina and Georgia, leading congregations at Center Grove Baptist in Clemmons and Curtis Baptist in Augusta before becoming Senior Pastor of First Baptist Charlotte, where he served for more than a decade and guided the church through difficult economic times without taking on debt.

Mark now represents the people of North Carolina's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he serves on the Agriculture, Education and Workforce, and Judiciary Committees, fighting every day for pro-family values, lower taxes, and a government that actually listens to the people it serves.

Mark and Beth have three adult children and eleven grandchildren, and call North Carolina home.

Now, Mark is running for reelection because North Carolina deserves a fighter in Washington who will never stop standing up for faith, family, and freedom. **

Maine Attorney General Aaron Frey (D) has signed Maine onto another national Democratic lawsuit against the Trump administration -- this one filed to stop Washington from asking a question that has been in federal immigration law since 1882: can this person support himself, or is he going to live on the taxpayer?
The rule Frey is trying to kill took effect Friday.
On July 20, the Department of Homeland Security published a final rule rescinding the Biden-era public-charge regulation of 2022. That 2022 rule had been a gift to the welfare-and-migration complex. It told immigration officers they could treat an applicant as a "public charge" only if the person was on cash welfare or parked in a government-funded institution. Food stamps didn't count. Medicaid didn't count. Public housing didn't count. The form was designed so that a green-card applicant could be drawing half the American safety net and still look, on paper, like a model of self-sufficiency.
This Substack is reader-supported. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pTun9Ao5nNBfXIFP_ZBaYc6mfzdlNKqx5g5cGAR7jxk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=216305806)
The Trump rule puts those programs back on the table. Starting with applications postmarked or filed electronically on Friday, Sept. 18, USCIS officers may weigh any means-tested public benefit the applicant receives from that date forward -- Medicaid and CHIP, SNAP, housing assistance, and the rest -- when they decide whether the person is "likely at any time to become a public charge."
Maine is currently one of the more generous states when it comes to handing out welfare to noncitizens, including illegal aliens.
Maine uses state money to give full Medicaid to noncitizen children and to pregnant women, including people with no legal status.
Maine also runs a parallel Food Stamp (SNAP) program for some legally present noncitizens federal law now excludes.
Maine towns pay General Assistance to asylum seekers and other people "pursuing a lawful process," for up to two years, though it's unclear whether there's any enforcement of immigration rules in GA.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..9sAziCpATiZoer6Jyz41_bM_A8J4VzkA_e38UGaGn2g?)
In 2025, Gov. Janet Mills proposed eliminating the Food Stamp "Hardship Exemption" for 5,000 non-citizens who were authorized to work but were not working. Those individuals were collecting Food Stamps at a cost to taxpayers of more than $2 million per biennial budget.
Democrat lawmakers killed that provision of Mills' budget.
